findingsAddressed.title: Lean Run contract still permits the Run to be an unbounded Findings and Verification ledger
findingsAddressed.fix: Section 4.1 retitled to '区分 formal authority 与 bounded envelope'. Replaced unbounded Agent notes layer with bounded envelope: Run does not copy complete Findings/Verification/archive facts (ref/01 section 2.1); holds only minimal result references (reviewVerdictRef → Reviewer result, verificationSummaryRef → verification.md, producedResultRefs, consumedInputRefs). Allowed minimal envelope fields: nextActionRecommendation, failureDiagnosis, blockedOn. Explicitly prohibited from copying into Run: complete findings, complete verification[], archiveResults/manifestUpdate/verificationResults, consistencyScan (not a Run schema field; if needed, output minimal result reference). Principles: Run is execution envelope not audit ledger (ref/01 section 6.3); complete facts stay with owning artifact; no second evidence subsystem. Section 5 table updated (serialization.ts, C1 delta, docs/core-model, tests rows). Section 7 acceptance: added '完整 Findings / Verification / archive 事实不复制进 Run（只持有 result references）'; changed 'Formal authority vs Agent notes' → 'Formal authority vs bounded envelope'. Section 8 cross-ref: 'formal vs Agent notes' → 'formal vs bounded envelope' with updated consistency requirement; Lean Run row updated to mention bounded envelope.
